alternative_solutions.description: When a shared roastery receives a lot, the operator opens a 15-minute inspection session and enters the lot size, origin, supplier, and sample weight. Instead of starting with a blank QA checklist, the app presents five to seven curated green-coffee defect fingerprints—such as full blacks, mold, insect damage, sour beans, and severe foreign matter—with compact photo-reference cards, distinguishing cues, and a concrete counting heuristic for each. The operator taps the matching fingerprint while counting the sample, records moisture, odor, temperature, and storage observations, and attaches quick photos when a finding is ambiguous. The decision engine compares the entered observations against the configured heuristics, labels the lot accept, conditional review, or reject, and generates a timestamped evidence sheet that can be sent to the supplier or retained with the receiving record.
alternative_solutions.differentiation_locus: The green-coffee receiving inspection workflow that starts from a curated defect fingerprint library and guides the operator through roastery-specific sampling heuristics to a rapid accept/reject decision.
